results.name: Finset.mem_toList
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toList {a : α} {s : Finset α} : a ∈ s.toList ↔ a ∈ s :=
  Multiset.mem_toList

results.name: List.finite_toSet
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem List.finite_toSet (l : List α) : { x | x ∈ l }.Finite :=
  (show Multiset α from ⟦l⟧).finite_toSet

results.name: Finset.toList_toFinset
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem toList_toFinset [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) : s.toList.toFinset = s := by
  ext
  simp
